natural.name: geopolitical_disruption
natural.description: Index of geopolitical/tariff-regime disruption severity affecting the supplier base.

natural.name: supplier_financial_health
natural.description: Composite financial-health score of the supplier (higher = healthier).

natural.name: supplier_distance
natural.description: Geographic distance (km) from supplier to buyer facility.

natural.name: po_cycle_time
natural.description: Purchase order cycle time in days, from issue to supplier acknowledgment.

natural.name: lead_time_variability
natural.description: Variability (std-dev-like measure, days) in observed delivery lead times.
natural.distribution: SCM: f(geopolitical_disruption, supplier_distance, supplier_risk_score, po_cycle_time) + noise

natural.name: safety_stock_held
natural.description: Units of safety stock held as a buffer against lead-time variability.

natural.name: raw_material_delay
natural.description: Observed delay (days) in raw material delivery.
